conviction_note: The one finding is a small reported-quarter lean: company arithmetic points to Q4 revenue and organic ASV at or slightly above the top of FY26 guidance, and the street already expects that. The stock trades on the FY27 guide, and I found no document on it; RBC's preview expects an ASV guide below consensus, and a guide like that sent the stock -10.4% in Sept 2025. The Q3 print (beat, guide held) went -3% premarket to +6.7%, so the reaction veto takes the +0.4 finding down to +0.3. That is close to an honest zero.
bar: Q4 FY26 revenue consensus $629.79M and EPS $4.35 (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/factset-q4fy26-results-analysts-raise-price-targets-ahead-earnings/51617239). Barchart has EPS at $4.32 (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/expect-factset-q4-2026-earnings-083838356.html), so the two EPS sources disagree slightly. The company FY26 revenue guide of $2,450-2,470M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1013237/000162828026046338/fdsq32026earningsrelease.htm), less 9M revenue of $1,841.5M, implies Q4 at $608.5-628.5M. The revenue consensus has one source and already sits above the top of the company guide, so sizes are capped small. The FY27 bar is Barchart's FY27 EPS of $19.84 against RBC's expected guide of $19.40-20.00, and RBC's expected organic ASV guide of $115-165M against a $151M consensus (https://www.bitget.com/news/detail/12560605741685).
positioning_check: Short interest is 10.86% of float, 5.41 days to cover, 3.84m shares (fintel, settlement 2026-09-15, https://fintel.io/ss/us/fds, via the sweep row). Ortex estimates 11.7% of free float on 2026-09-19 falling to 10.0% (3.74m) on 2026-09-28, with a 13% drop on 2026-09-24 (https://ortex.news/articles/173981/fds-shorts-retreat-after-the-print-bears-rethink-their-bet; that article misdescribes the print date, but its SI series is usable). Skew is +2.16 vol points and put/call OI is 2.72 per the baseline, a modest downside lean with puts heavily owned. So this is a moderately crowded short into a -17.5% 20-day slide. No negative finding was filed.

findings.finding: Q4 FY26 likely lands at or above the top of the company's FY26 revenue and organic-ASV guides. Trailing-12-month organic ASV was already +$165.0M (7.1%) at 2026-05-31, against a full-year guide of $130-160M. Q3 revenue grew 6.4% YoY; the same growth on Q4 FY25's $596.9M gives about $635M, against a $629.8M consensus and a guide-implied top of $628.5M. The CEO said Q4 bookings were ahead of last year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY26 (2026-07-01): adj EPS $4.53 vs $4.45 and organic ASV +7.1%, guide only reaffirmed. It traded -3% premarket and closed +6.7% per the baseline. Q2 FY26 was +6.08%. In Sept 2025 (the last Q4 print) Q4 organic ASV was a record $81.8M, but the stock fell 10.36% on the FY26 margin/EPS guide. The reported quarter does not decide the Q4 print.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The revenue consensus ($629.8M) already sits above the guide-implied top ($628.5M), and RBC's 2026-08-27 preview calls for a revenue beat. If the market were pricing a miss, the consensus would sit inside the guide and previews would flag ASV risk; neither is true. The only unpriced part is the ~$5M gap between run-rate arithmetic and consensus. That is inference from growth carry, not a disclosed number, and it lands inside what management told the market to expect ('tracking toward the high end').
findings.independence: RBC preview (2026-08-27) independently expects a Q4 revenue beat on pipeline strength (https://www.bitget.com/news/detail/12560605741685). Peer demand after FactSet last spoke also points the same way: MSCI Q2 2026 had a record hedge-fund quarter and 95.3% retention (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260721880634/en/MSCI-Reports-Financial-Results-for-Second-Quarter-and-Six-Months-2026), and LSEG H1 2026 subscription growth accelerated to 6.3% (https://www.lseg.com/en/media-centre/press-releases/2026/london-stock-exchange-group-plc-h1-2026-interim-results). CEO bookings commentary is from the Q3 call transcript (https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/markets-news/motley/3088972/factset-fds-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/).

searched_and_found_nothing: Cause of the -17.5% 20-day slide. It is sector and narrative, not company-specific: OpenAI's ChatGPT for Financial Services (Sept 2026, https://allwork.space/2026/09/openai-launches-finance-specific-chatgpt-to-take-on-more-wall-street-work) sent FDS about -5% to -6% on 2026-09-10, per the ad-hoc-news aggregator; that launch lists FactSet as an optimized connector, so it cuts both ways. Meta Muse drove the 09-22/09-23 financials selloff (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-22/meta-s-muse-drags-down-stocks-that-depend-on-consumer-inertia), and a Fed hike drove the 09-29 risk-off (https://premarketbrief.substack.com/p/daily-market-brief-september-29-2026). No company document explains it, so it is worth 0.

8-K of 2026-08-31, credit agreement Amendment No. 1 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1013237/000095015726000966/form8-k.htm): revolver raised from $1.0B to $1.5B, the $375M term loan extended to 2029, and the revolver to 2031. No stated use. The only corroborated use is the small BCC Group tuck-in of 2026-09-22 (https://investor.factset.com/news-releases/news-release-details/factset-marks-new-era-enterprise-real-time-market-data-it) plus ongoing buybacks ($203.1M in Q3, $494.0M authorization remaining). No distress; signed 0.

8-K of 2026-09-25 (director Marcel Prins, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1013237/000162828026063495/fds-20260923.htm) and the Form 4s of 09-24/09-25 (CEO RSU tax withholding at $276.42; CAO PSU certification of 97 units, no percentage of target disclosed). No insider buying or selling signal.

Layoff and headcount signals: the ~10% tech workforce reduction and $19.6M Q3 restructuring charge are already in the Q3 call and release. No new Aug-Sept layoff document found (interviewpal/Glassdoor are unsourced aggregators).

FY27 margin guide: no company statement beyond 'clear line of sight on margin improvement' on the Q3 call. The sell-side (RBC) expects modest expansion and an EPS guide of $19.40-20.00 against $19.84 consensus. That is wire, not unpriced.
Enterprise wins or replacement deals (wealth/banks) in Jun-Sep 2026: none found.
baseline_tension: Nothing I found beats the baseline. The mildly positive reported-quarter lean runs against a modest +2.16 put skew and 2.72 put/call OI. The FY27 guide risk those puts hedge is real and undocumented either way. The -17.5% run-up and ~10-11% short interest make a sell-the-news drop less likely than last September, which is why the lean survives at all, and only at +0.3.
lessons_applied: Rules 6 and 1 cut the reported-quarter finding from +0.7 to +0.4. It lands at the top of a range management already said it was tracking toward, the revenue consensus has one source and already sits above the guide top, and this name trades on the FY guide, not the quarter (Sept 2025 record ASV quarter, -10.4%).

Rules 5 and 7 dropped the +0.8 positioning finding: sector/AI-driven drawdown, 10-11% SI, puts crowded, last two prints reversed up. It was an oversold-and-shorted argument with no company document, its sign ran against the (modest) put skew, and a crowded short is a reason to shrink negatives, not to manufacture a positive.
Rule 3: the note says the FY27 guide swing is undocumented, so expected_move (+0.3) sits below the finding sum (+0.4). print_vs_bar cut from +0.8 to +0.5 for the one-source bar cap.
Rule 4 confirmed that the 08-31 revolver upsizing stays at 0: no distress, and the corroborated uses are buybacks and a tuck-in.
